caption:
Your ad budget and your revenue budget are not the same thing.

Most shops fund one bucket: attraction. Ads, SEO, referrals. That buys opportunities. It doesn't buy revenue.

Two other buckets decide if those opportunities become booked jobs and repeat customers: capture (speed to lead, automated follow-up) and compounding (reviews, win-backs, referrals from past jobs).

This week: pull your last 30 days of spend and split it three ways. If capture and compounding read zero, you're not running a marketing budget. You're running an ad budget and hoping the rest handles itself.
